how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:rogue-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1858:obj:0: Steal Tazan's key, then use it to open his Satchel and deliver its contents to Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1858:details:0: I'll leave it to you to get Tazan's satchel open, and return to me with its contents. The locking mechanism is complex, so it would probably be easiest if you obtained the key.
rows.quest:1858:details:1: BAs you didn't find it on Tazan's body, I can only assume that he left the key in the care of another... Ah, yes, that's right. He had an assistant named Gamon. A drunkard, you'll most likely find him at the tavern. Perhaps you could quietly relieve him of the key.
rows.quest:1858:completion:0: Hmmm, now this is interesting. You've more than proved your worth with this, ⟦1⟧. I am quite impressed. Consider yourself the newest member of the Shattered Hand. And take this, it will be a great help to you in the future, I think.
rows.quest:1859:obj:0: Speak with Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1859:details:0: Lower your voice, ⟦2⟧. Yeah, I know your name. Was told to keep an eye out for an orc by your description.
rows.quest:1859:details:1: BFrom what we've heard about you, you can handle yourself in combat, and aren't opposed to a little sneakery from time to time.
rows.quest:1859:details:3: BAnyways, you should go see Therzok in ⟦E1⟧. He's got an offer for you to hear.
rows.quest:1859:completion:0: Very good, I'm glad Kaplak was able to get a hold of you.
rows.quest:1859:completion:1: BWe have some things to speak of, not the least of which is your future with the Hand.
rows.quest:1885:obj:0: Speak with Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1885:details:0: ⟦3⟧? Not quite what I was expecting, considering Carkad himself has taken an interest to you. Looks can be deceiving though, right?
rows.quest:1885:details:1: BEither way, you should go see him as soon as possible. You wouldn't want to know what happened to the last few that chose to ignore his summons.
rows.quest:1885:completion:0: Hm. No doubt you made your way here at first mention of my summons, yes? Of course. I would expect no less from a prospective Deathstalker.
rows.quest:1886:obj:0: Get Astor's Letter of Introduction and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter.
rows.quest:1886:details:0: If you wish to join the Deathstalkers, Lord Varimathras' elite guard, you will have to prove your worth.
rows.quest:1886:details:1: BI will not lie to you, ⟦4⟧, this task could mean your death.
rows.quest:1886:details:2: BI have some things that need attending to. I require the personal effects of Astor Hadren, a messenger who travels between Silverpine and the ⟦E2⟧. I will leave the method of procurement to your discretion.
rows.quest:1886:details:3: BIt will be better for you if you know less of the nature of this business. Succeed and I shall tell you more.
rows.quest:1886:completion:0: Well done, ⟦5⟧. You've passed the first part of this test. Hopefully Andron will not have caught wind of your activities, and we will be able to convince him that you are, in fact, the messenger he is expecting.
rows.quest:1898:obj:0: Speak with Andron Gant in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1898:details:0: The letter of introduction should be enough to convince Andron that you are the messenger he's been waiting for. I've met Andron before, he doesn't quite have the mental capacity to be that suspicious.
rows.quest:1898:details:1: BLord Varimathras suspects that Andron has been providing aid to some other group. He wishes to know what organization this is and requires proof of it.
rows.quest:1898:details:2: BI want you to speak with Andron, and obtain this information. You'll find him at his shop near the Apothecarium.
rows.quest:1898:completion:0: Ah, yes, I've been expecting you. I have no doubt our mutual acquaintances are pleased with the information that I have provided so far?
rows.quest:1898:completion:1: BI suppose there's no point in asking you, I doubt they would burden you with this knowledge. Why place so much trust in the messenger, hm?
rows.quest:1899:obj:0: Bring Andron's Ledger to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1899:details:0: You'll find the ledger with the information your employers seek on the bookshelf behind me. Deliver it with my regards, and tell them that I would prefer it if they sent you, if they find enough value that they should wish to continue our arrangement.
rows.quest:1899:completion:0: Well, this is certainly more information than I suspected to get out of Andron. Give me a moment to peruse it, before I set you to your next task.
rows.quest:1963:obj:0: Kill Tazan and bring his Satchel to Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1963:details:0: The Warchief is too subtle in his methods. He is cautious to unleash the might of the ⟦E3⟧. Once we were stronger, mighty conquerors all. That pride we must regain, and the Shattered Hand will do so.
rows.quest:1963:details:1: BWe build strength from the shadows and strike at the exposed, secretly laying our enemies low. A task you must complete for me, to prove your worth.
rows.quest:1963:details:2: BThe troll Tazan trades with the pirates near Ratchet. He has information I must have. Kill him and bring me his satchel.
rows.quest:1963:completion:0: Hm, while I am glad to hear that Tazan is no longer with us, a locked satchel does us no good. We need the information kept within.
rows.quest:1963:completion:1: BThis should prove a worthy second challenge for one who wishes to join the Shattered Hand.
rows.quest:1978:obj:0: Deliver Andron's Ledger to Varimathras in the Hall of the Dark Lady in the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1978:details:0: The ⟦E4⟧? I would never have suspected. It seems the lords of Alterac have fallen far in the years since their betrayal.
rows.quest:1978:details:1: BLord Varimathras will be pleased to learn of this, and as you were so instrumental in this discovery, it would be fitting if you were the one to deliver it to him.
rows.quest:1978:details:2: BAh, and how could I forget?
rows.quest:1978:completion:0: Hmm, this is interesting. The Deathstalkers have performed their duties admirably in ferreting this out.
rows.quest:1978:completion:1: BFrom what I understand, you also deserve commendation for your performance. I hope that this will become routine for you, ⟦6⟧, my Deathstalkers always have use of a good man.
rows.quest:1998:obj:0: Kill Fenwick Thatros and bring his head back to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1998:details:0: Lord Varimathras has just sent me a missive about a threat to the ⟦E5⟧ that must be immediately removed. His name is Fenwick Thatros, one whom Lord Varimathras believes is a leader of the undead that have taken root in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1998:details:1: BYour name came to mind immediately, ⟦7⟧. I have faith enough in your abilities that you will carry out this mission flawlessly.
rows.quest:1998:details:2: BThe latest reports from the Deathstalkers in Silverpine indicate that Thatros can be found near the decrepit dock on Lordamere.
rows.quest:1998:completion:0: You've done well, ⟦8⟧. It occurs to me that you have performed many services for the Deathstalkers, proving your worth, and that perhaps it is time that we furthered your training in the shadow arts.
rows.quest:1999:obj:0: Find the ⟦E7⟧ Status Report and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1999:details:0: The wizards of the Kirin ⟦E8⟧ at Ambermill have stored away important documents pertaining to the current state of ⟦E7⟧. This we know from the admissions of one of our prisoners. Lord Varimathras has placed the duty of recovering them in the hands of the Deathstalkers.
rows.quest:1999:details:1: BThis task falls to you, ⟦9⟧. You will need some equipment, however, and the knowledge of lockpicking. Speak with Estelle Gendry, our outfitter, and ask her for a set of tools before you set out.
rows.quest:1999:completion:0: Very good, ⟦10⟧! You have learned the fine art of lockpicking well, and faster than I could have possibly expected.
rows.quest:1999:completion:1: BI see that I was right to place my trust in you. Believe me, boy, I foresee that you will go far in this line of work.
rows.quest:2205:obj:0: Deliver Keryn Sylvius's package to Master Mathias Shaw at the ⟦E9⟧ Barracks.
rows.quest:2205:details:0: The badge? Oh, it's nothing, fish - nothing you could handle anyhow. By the looks of you, I'd say Mathias is likely to mistake you for the cheese delivery ⟦11⟧ instead of a proper rogue. Regardless, I've been assigned a job and I've made a promise to deliver on that job.
rows.quest:2205:details:1: BSpeaking of which, deliver this package to Mathias and he may give you a small task or two.
rows.quest:2205:completion:0: You found me - and by looking at you, I'd say the run and subsequent search may have been a great strain on your system, both mentally and physically.
rows.quest:2205:completion:1: BWould you like Renzik to show you the way to an inn or are you ready for some work?
rows.quest:2206:obj:0: Find the Defias Dockmaster and recover the Shipping Schedule for Master Mathias Shaw.⟦13⟧
rows.quest:2206:details:0: Our operatives in the field are reporting heavy Defias activity south of Goldshire. The reports indicate that the Defias have taken over Jerod's Landing and are now using it as a way to smuggle large quantities of contraband from Redridge to ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:2206:details:1: BI need you to infiltrate the dock house and get me that shipping schedule, ⟦14⟧. You will probably find it buried deep in the pockets of the Dockmaster.
rows.quest:2206:details:2: B...and ⟦15⟧, should you be discovered, SI:7 will disavow all knowledge of your existence.
rows.quest:2206:completion:0: I am astonished... Astonished that Keryn finally found a recruit that could possibly have the makings of a proper ⟦16⟧. Take this blade, ⟦17⟧. A day will come when you will be called upon again to serve the SI:7. Hone your skills, keep your eyes open and that blade sharp.
rows.quest:2206:completion:1: BYou won't see us coming but you'll feel it when we get there...
rows.quest:2218:details:0: Another lost soul looking for guidance, eh? I suppose you want to find a purpose - your purpose. I've seen it a thousand times, another hero looking for work.
rows.quest:2218:details:1: BWell, today's your lucky day, friend. Hogral's got the cure for your ailment.
rows.quest:2218:details:2: BHere's what you do: Take this road here up to ⟦E11⟧ and make your way to the Forlorn Cavern. Once there, locate the thieves' guild and speak with Hulfdan Blackbeard. He'll put you on the road to ⟦E12⟧.⟦18⟧
rows.quest:2218:completion:0: So ye think yer a right scoundrel? Destined to be one o' Blackbeard's chosen few - an officer o' the Hidden Circle?
rows.quest:2218:completion:1: BOnly a good fer nothin' scallywag would think so highly o' hisself.
rows.quest:2218:completion:2: BThat's exactly what we be lookin' fer! Welcome aboard, ⟦19⟧!
rows.quest:2238:details:0: Ye see, the King be strip mining the quarry fer ore and gems. More riches than any one dwarf should see in ten lifetimes.
rows.quest:2238:details:1: BThe Hidden Circle has values, ⟦20⟧. We value valuables. Can ye understand?
rows.quest:2238:details:2: BNow we feels the King should be sharing some of that booty, but we don't want ol' 'Stinkbeard' to know he's sharin' - if ye catch me drift.
rows.quest:2238:details:3: BWe needs ye to speak with Onin MacHammar over by Gnomeregan and bring back a report. The crafty dwarf has hidden hisself amongst the lepers. Be careful.
rows.quest:2238:completion:0: Shhhh! Keep it down you daft fool. They'll hear us.
rows.quest:2239:obj:0: Take Onin's Report back to Hulfdan in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:2239:details:0: The Quarry? Yap, I see those monstrous armored steam tanks come by this post near every day.
rows.quest:2239:details:1: BMy contacts to the east tell me that the tank starts off at ⟦E11⟧, makes a pickup at the Gol'Bolar Quarry, stops over at Kharanos to refuel and then for some blasted reason, it takes the long way around past Gnomeregan, before reaching ⟦E11⟧ to drop off the shipment.
rows.quest:2239:details:2: BIt's all in the report, ⟦21⟧. Take it back to Hulfdan so he can plan the next step.⟦22⟧
rows.quest:2239:completion:0: Long route? In the name o' me own beard!
rows.quest:2239:completion:1: BYe done good, ⟦23⟧. Take this dagger and be gone with ye. The Circle will call upon ye again when step three be ready to be set into motion.
rows.quest:2239:completion:2: BWhat's step three? It comes right after step two - me putting me boot up yer backside.
rows.quest:2241:obj:0: Take Jannok's Rose to Syurna in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:2241:details:0: They say I'm 'lovestruck,' whatever that means.
rows.quest:2241:details:1: BSure, I spend my every waking moment thinking about Syurna. Sure, my home is full of paintings and drawings of Syurna. Sure, I often go days without eating, sleeping, or drinking, while I lament about the love we could have had. Is that so wrong?
rows.quest:2241:details:2: BNow she won't see me! ME! I've tried sending her messages but she won't even talk to another person unless they are a rogue.
rows.quest:2241:details:3: BCould you deliver this flower to her? Don't forget to tell her it's from Jannok.
rows.quest:2241:completion:0: Had I saved every flower that dolt, Jannok, had sent me, I would have had the means to open a shop. Regardless, it seems as if Jannok's latest courier may prove to be useful.Interested in some work, ⟦24⟧?
rows.quest:2242:obj:0: Find Sethir the Ancient and bring back any clues that you may discover to Syurna.⟦25⟧
rows.quest:2242:details:0: We believe there is one being that may be able to help us understand what is happening to the forests of ⟦E14⟧. Unfortunately, getting the creature to cooperate has proven disastrous.
rows.quest:2242:details:1: BHe hides on a branch at the outskirts of the Oracle Glade. All who have so far approached the satyr, whether through force or diplomacy, have met with doom. Perhaps stealth is the answer, ⟦26⟧.
rows.quest:2242:details:2: BFind what Sethir the Ancient carries in his packs and report back to me.⟦27⟧
rows.quest:2242:completion:0: This is grim news, ⟦28⟧. It would seem that the sickness which has gripped the forests and rivers of ⟦E15⟧ has begun to taint our home.
rows.quest:2242:completion:1: BYou have served us well, but there is nothing more you can do here. Take this blade as a reward for your service to ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:2259:details:0: Do not worry, ⟦30⟧, I am not sending you to see Syurna. Erion requires your presence at the Cenarion Enclave. Make haste!
rows.quest:2259:completion:0: It is time to branch out, ⟦31⟧ - the world awaits.
rows.quest:2260:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to ⟦E17⟧ and seek council with Renzik "The Shiv."⟦32⟧
rows.quest:2260:details:0: Word of your deeds has spread far and wide, ⟦33⟧. So far, in fact, that ⟦E9⟧ Intelligence has asked for you by name.
rows.quest:2260:details:1: BThe journey is taxing and not without peril, but an opportunity to train under SI:7 should not be taken lightly.
rows.quest:2260:details:2: BA new world awaits you, ⟦34⟧. Make your way to Old Town in ⟦E9⟧ and speak with Renzik "The Shiv" at SI:7 headquarters.⟦35⟧
rows.quest:2260:completion:0: You have answered SI:7's calling, ⟦36⟧ and journeyed from distant shores to join our ranks, however, there is much for you to learn.
rows.quest:2281:obj:0: Venture forth to Lakeshire in the ⟦E18⟧ and speak with Lucius.⟦37⟧
rows.quest:2281:details:0: Sending you out in the field now would be suicide. Renzik doesn't need another dead rogue on his hands. Don't fret, though, ⟦38⟧ - Renzik is going to get you up to speed.
rows.quest:2281:details:1: BMake your way to the ⟦E18⟧ and speak with an associate of SI:7 named Lucius. You will find him hanging around the docks of Lakeshire with the other shady good-for-nothings.
rows.quest:2281:completion:0: Ah, so your fingers are a little fat, eh? Don't worry, ⟦39⟧, I've turned more useless thieves than you into accomplished rogues.
rows.quest:2282:obj:0: Open Lucius's Lockbox, recover the Token of Thievery and return it to Lucius in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:2282:details:0: We've been training thieves here for years! After all, not every rapscallion is born with the grace and finesse of old Lucius.
rows.quest:2282:details:1: BUp off the road here you'll find Alther's Mill. I got a chest up there with something important inside. Go get it for me! Bring back that token and you'll receive your Certificate of Thievery!
rows.quest:2282:completion:0: Cracked it open, did you? Nice work, ⟦40⟧.
rows.quest:2282:completion:1: BIf you die now, we can rest easy knowing it was due to your own stupidity and not inexperience.
rows.quest:2298:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to ⟦E9⟧ and seek out Renzik "The Shiv."
rows.quest:2298:details:0: So there we were, about to start plottin' out phase III when a couple o' Magni's blockheads come bargin' in here talkin' bout some kind o' heist and arresting some o' the Hidden Circle.
rows.quest:2298:details:1: BWell nobody puts the iron on old Blackbeard! The argumentations got heavy and thick and somehow yer name weres blurted out!
rows.quest:2298:details:2: BMe advice? Take the first Gryphon out o' ⟦E11⟧ and get to ⟦E9⟧. Get yerself to Old Town and once there, talk to an old friend o' mine named Renzik "The Shiv."
rows.quest:2298:completion:0: It's always good to have one of Hulfdan's rogues among our ranks!
rows.quest:2299:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to ⟦E11⟧ and speak with Hulfdan Blackbeard.
rows.quest:2299:details:0: Where have you been, ⟦41⟧? Hulfdan's been looking all over the place for you. We thought the king may have put you in irons.
rows.quest:2299:details:1: BGet to ⟦E11⟧ as soon as possible and speak with Hulfdan!
rows.quest:2299:completion:0: Keep yer voice down, ⟦42⟧, the guards may hear ye.
rows.quest:2300:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to ⟦E9⟧ and seek out Renzik "The Shiv."⟦43⟧
rows.quest:2300:details:0: Renzik was looking for you, fish.
rows.quest:2300:details:1: BI wouldn't keep Mathias's second in command waiting if I were you.⟦44⟧
rows.quest:2300:completion:0: Are you ready to get to work or do you need to take a nap before we get started?
rows.quest:2358:obj:0: Return the Horns of Nez'ra to Arantir's Shadow in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:2358:details:0: Many years ago, the Horns of Nez'ra were stolen from Ravenholdt manor. Across continents and oceans I have searched, only to discover that these insignificant beasts have had it in their possession all along.
rows.quest:2358:details:1: BSlay every Blackrock orc you cross until the Horns of Nez'ra are recovered. Should you recover the horns, find me in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:2358:details:2: BDo this for me and your name shall be known to Ravenholdt, ⟦45⟧.
rows.quest:2358:completion:0: To deny Ravenholdt the artifact, would be to deny one's own existence. Well done, ⟦46⟧. You may yet walk among the assassins of Ravenholdt.
rows.quest:2358:completion:1: BAs a young rogue adventuring in ⟦E15⟧, I discovered a tea that replenishes energy in combat. It has served me well throughout the years and now I pass on a taste of the thistle tea to you. Drink of it when you tire, ⟦47⟧, and fight with vigor once more!
rows.quest:2359:obj:0: Steal the Defias Tower Key, break into the Defias Tower and uncover the contents of the ⟦E19⟧ Chest. Take whatever information you find back to Mathias Shaw in ⟦E9⟧. Read Kearnen's Journal to gain insight about the tower.⟦48⟧
rows.quest:2359:details:0: I've been staking out this tower for weeks, ⟦49⟧. Recently a major shipment came through from ⟦E19⟧, and along with it came those guards.
rows.quest:2359:details:1: BWhat are they? Your guess is as good as mine. I can tell you one thing - they aren't human.
rows.quest:2359:details:2: BAnyhow, the shipment had a chest - which is what I assume those abominations are guarding. The zombie with the spikes holds a key we'll need.
rows.quest:2359:details:3: BGet that key, get in the tower, and uncover whatever is in that chest. Take your findings back to Mathias.
rows.quest:2359:completion:0: This would explain the Defias drones you and Kearnen saw outside of the tower, ⟦50⟧. It would also explain the Venture Company's involvement with the Defias and the strange shipments out of ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:2359:completion:1: BAccording to this book, the Zanzil trolls in Stranglethorn have discovered a way to raise the dead through potions... or to be more specific: poison.
rows.quest:2359:completion:2: BYou'll be of no use to SI:7 without a firm understanding of poisons, ⟦51⟧ -- especially with the recipe to create undeath at our fingertips.
rows.quest:2360:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to ⟦E10⟧ and find Agent Kearnen for your debriefing.
rows.quest:2360:details:0: Not a moment too soon, ⟦52⟧. SI:7 reconnaissance is reporting unusually heavy Defias activity in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:2360:details:1: BIt would seem that the Defias have taken over an abandoned ⟦E20⟧ watch tower southeast of Sentinel Hill and are using it as a base of operations to smuggle in goods from the Redridge supply route.
rows.quest:2360:details:2: BGet to ⟦E10⟧ and contact Agent Kearnen for your debriefing. You will find her hidden near the tower.
rows.quest:2360:details:3: B...and ⟦53⟧, should you be discovered, SI:7 will disavow all knowledge of your existence.
rows.quest:2360:completion:0: Mathias finally sent another agent to back me up, eh? Well I hope he's ready to hear some bad news.
rows.quest:2378:obj:0: Journey to ⟦E1⟧ and speak with Shenthul at the Cleft of Shadow.
rows.quest:2378:details:0: You have served the Deathstalkers well, ⟦54⟧, but perhaps it is time for you to venture outward. While you have shown aptitude in the ways of stealth and deception, you still require much training.
rows.quest:2378:details:1: BThe Deathstalkers have allies within the Shattered Hand. Seek out those that would assist us - find Shenthul in ⟦E1⟧.⟦55⟧
rows.quest:2378:completion:0: So, you are what our mighty allies have sent Shenthul? How uninspiring....
rows.quest:2379:obj:0: Speak with Zando'zan at the Cleft of Shadow.
rows.quest:2379:details:0: Your determination alone is not enough to overcome the obstacles that lay ahead of us.
rows.quest:2379:details:1: BSpeak with Zando'zan to begin your training as an operative of the Shattered Hand.
rows.quest:2379:details:2: BIt is only when you have mastered the practices of stealth and thievery that you may take the next step towards your destiny.⟦56⟧
rows.quest:2379:completion:0: Perhaps Zando'zan was wrong. Zando'zan apologizes.
rows.quest:2380:obj:0: Speak with Shenthul at the Cleft of Shadow in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:2380:details:0: A master of stealth and deception you are not, however, all of that can and will change. You've obviously impressed those in charge with your meager skills, as the great Shenthul has asked for you by name.
rows.quest:2380:details:1: BTake the road north of here to ⟦E1⟧ and speak with Shenthul in the Cleft of Shadow.⟦57⟧
rows.quest:2380:completion:0: It is important that the Shattered Hand remains vigilant in the face of the changes Thrall wishes to bring about to the ⟦E3⟧. Our numbers alone will not be enough to overcome his rule - stealth and deception must be mastered.
rows.quest:2381:obj:0: Bring the Southsea Treasure back to Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet. Do not forget to get an E.C.A.C. and Thieves' Tools from Wrenix's Gizmotronic Apparatus. You will need both of these items to complete your mission.
rows.quest:2381:obj:1: BShould you be attacked by any unusually hostile parrots, use your E.C.A.C.!
rows.quest:2381:details:0: I don't mean to scare you, ⟦58⟧, but the last five thieves I sent to steal the southsea treasure came back to me in pieces.
rows.quest:2381:details:1: BSouth along the coast you'll find Tide Razor, the southsea freebooter's ship. Nestled in the hold is the payoff - the southsea treasure. On the second level of that ship is the pirate's den, a place where they train all of their thieves.
rows.quest:2381:details:2: BBoard that ship, steal the treasure, and bring it back to me. Use the pirate's den if you need to practice your thievery, but be careful!⟦59⟧
rows.quest:2381:completion:0: Incredible! Improbable! Simply amazing! You've got talent, Weir. Either that or you're the luckiest man alive!
rows.quest:2381:completion:1: BHere's your cut of the action. I'm sure you would make better use of this stuff than I could.
rows.quest:2382:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to Ratchet and speak with Wrenix the Wretched.
rows.quest:2382:details:0: Zando'zan has seen it! Yes, the day comes! Thrall's death... the dagger in his back, poison seeping through to his every vein... Zando'zan has said too much.
rows.quest:2382:details:1: B⟦60⟧! Zando'zan has a task for ⟦61⟧! ⟦62⟧ must travel to Ratchet, east of the Crossroads, and speak with Wrenix the Wretched. Go!⟦63⟧
rows.quest:2382:completion:0: Another one? The last five that crazy troll sent me ended up as shark food. Let's hope you fare a little better, eh?
rows.quest:2458:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to the Venture Co. Tower, north of the Sludge Fen and contact the Shattered Hand's covert operative, Taskmaster Fizzule.
rows.quest:2458:obj:1: BWhen the tower is in sight, use the Flare Gun to signal your arrival to Taskmaster Fizzule. ⟦E21⟧ off TWO flares, then approach Taskmaster Fizzule and perform the Shattered /Salute.
rows.quest:2458:obj:2: BThese actions must be performed in the correct order, as Fizzule will attack and terminate any person he does not recognize.
rows.quest:2458:details:0: The Venture Company... Perhaps you have heard of them?
rows.quest:2458:details:1: BFor one year we have worked on planting an agent deep within their ranks. Through much hard work and careful planning, we succeeded.
rows.quest:2458:details:2: BRecently we received word that the Venture Co. are planning something on a grand scale. Go north of the Sludge Fen to the Venture Co. tower and contact our undercover agent, Taskmaster Fizzule.
rows.quest:2458:details:3: BWhen you find the tower, use this flare gun, then approach Fizzule and show him the salute of the Shattered Hand.⟦64⟧
rows.quest:2458:completion:0: It's good to see another agent of the Shattered Hand in these parts, however, the flare may have been a little too much!
rows.quest:2458:completion:1: BNext time you need to speak with me, blow into this whistle twice and I'll know you are an ally.
rows.quest:2460:obj:0: Perform the Shattered Salute on Shenthul.
rows.quest:2460:details:0: As a rogue of the Shattered Hand, it is imperative that you learn the Shattered Salute. It is the only way to truly identify another member of the Hand.
rows.quest:2460:completion:0: Well done, ⟦65⟧. You are now ready to proceed.
rows.quest:2478:obj:0: Steal Silixiz's Tower Key from ⟦E22⟧ Silixiz, then kill two Mutated Venture Co. Drones, two Venture Co. Patrollers, and two Venture Co. Lookouts.
rows.quest:2478:obj:1: BAssassinate Grand ⟦E22⟧ Gallywix and take his head, then pick the lock on Gallywix's lockbox and steal the Cache of Zanzil's Altered Mixture. Take the Cache and Gallywix's Head back to Shenthul in ⟦E1⟧ for further instruction.⟦66⟧
rows.quest:2478:details:0: You will need to steal the tower key from ⟦E22⟧ Silixiz, ⟦67⟧. Once you've got the key in your possession, hold on to it - I may need it later.
rows.quest:2478:details:1: BRemember, the poison has weakened everything in this tower. Use your abilities to bring chaos and destruction to its inhabitants. Slay them all -- show no mercy!
rows.quest:2478:details:2: BOnce everything inside lays in a bloodied heap, pick Gallywix's lockbox and steal the cache of Zanzil's mixture held inside. Take both the head of Gallywix and the mixture to Shenthul in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:2478:completion:0: Poor Fizzule, he was a good agent -- one of our best. Alas, it is the price we pay, ⟦68⟧. Being a field agent of the Shattered Hand is dangerous work.
rows.quest:2478:completion:1: BYou have performed your duty well, ⟦69⟧. It would be a shame if you did not live to serve us again.
rows.quest:2479:obj:0: ⟦E16⟧ to Tarren Mill in ⟦E23⟧ and deliver the Sample of Zanzil's Mixture to Serge Hinott.
rows.quest:2479:obj:1: BTo get to Tarren Mill, take the Zeppelin to the ⟦E2⟧ and follow the road south through Silverpine and towards Hillsbrad. Follow the signs!
rows.quest:2479:details:0: Take a sample of the mixture to Serge Hinott in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:2479:details:1: BIf anyone can cure you, it's Serge. Live long enough and Serge will show you the ways of poison creation and use.
rows.quest:2479:completion:0: You look deliciously pale, ⟦70⟧. And what is that foul aroma you are giving off? I must know!
rows.quest:2480:obj:0: Wait for Serge Hinott to complete the cure.
rows.quest:2480:details:0: I have never seen such wondrous results from a poison! Zanzil you say? Never heard of him, however, I must commend him on the creation of this concoction.
rows.quest:2480:details:1: BSo, I am to cure you of this and then teach you how to make use of the poison?
rows.quest:2480:details:2: BGive me a few moments to examine the toxin, ⟦71⟧.
rows.quest:2480:completion:0: The cure is ready! Drink this anti-toxin and the creeping madness will stop, however, I will not be able to do anything about the smell.
rows.quest:2607:obj:0: Speak with Doc Mixilpixil in the cellar of the Barracks.
rows.quest:2607:details:0: It appears as if you've brought back more information than even I expected. This certainly is a strange turn of events, ⟦72⟧.
rows.quest:2607:details:1: BA cure? Hrm... Go down to the cellar and speak with Doc Mixilpixil - he may be able to help.
rows.quest:2607:completion:0: It's about time! Just put the cheese on the table and skedaddle. Osborne will pay you on the way out.
rows.quest:2608:obj:0: /Lay down to be examined by Doc Mixilpixil. How can he find the cure if he can't find the cause?⟦73⟧
rows.quest:2608:details:0: Oh my, you look like death. Correction - I've seen death, you look worse than death. You, ⟦74⟧, would be what death coughed up at his last physical.
rows.quest:2608:details:1: BHah! You hear that Noarm? Write that one down!
rows.quest:2608:details:2: B*Cough* Hrm yes, in order for me to help you, I'll need to draw some blood. Don't worry, it only hurts the first few... fifty times or so... /lay down when you're ready for the treatment, ⟦75⟧.
rows.quest:2608:completion:0: Give me a moment to confer with my colleagues, ⟦76⟧. Dr. Montgomery, Mr. Noarm, let us conference!
rows.quest:2609:obj:0: Bring Doc Mixilpixil one bundle of Simple Wildflowers, one Leaded Vial, one Bronze Tube, and one Spool of Light Chartreuse Silk Thread. The 'itis' doesn't cure itself, young ⟦77⟧.
rows.quest:2609:details:1: BLuckily, I have a cure for the 'itis.'
rows.quest:2609:details:2: BHere's what I need: One bundle of simple wildflowers, one leaded vial, one bronze tube, and last but certainly not least, one spool of light chartreuse ⟦E24⟧ thread. Ol' Emma left a spool of it for me at 'The Finest Thread.' You can find the shop along the canals.
rows.quest:2609:details:3: BHurry along now, ⟦79⟧, and try not to touch anyone until you're cured. Oh, and Dr. Montgomery says you need a shower -- his words, not mine.
rows.quest:2609:completion:0: What am I doing? What does it look like I'm doing? I'm devising a cure for your 'itis!' Don't get indignant with me now, ⟦80⟧!
rows.quest:2609:completion:1: BJust a few more seconds. There! Just spray this, um, fantastic smelling medicine on yourself and you'll be as good as new.
